# quant-kg-lab — Roadmap

> **Mission**: consolidate the 28 library graphs + skills into a single **gold standard**
> — verifiable, uniform, and composable — then keep the truth surface mechanically honest.
> Canonical specs: `docs/specs/SKILL_SPEC.md`, `docs/specs/GRAPH_SPEC.md`. Pins: `graphs.lock`.
> Planning/tracking lives in the hermes-vault PRD index (QKG_001–074); this file is the pointer + live status.
> Headline numbers are generated: `scripts/emit_counts.py` (QKG_065) — never hand-edit counts.

## State of the repo (generated by `scripts/emit_counts.py --markdown`)

**Gold standard reached for all 28 libraries**: every graph passes the quality gate; 136 spec-normalized skills (27 routers + 97 modules + 12 playbooks); graph-node citations (1147, 0 dangling); 71/71 cross-library bridges; 126-doc governed corpus; provenance-gated CI.

| Layer | State |
|-------|-------|
| Knowledge graphs | **28/28 extracted** (~92K nodes, ~230K edges) — 19 original + Wave-3 (catboost, ta, darts) + prior expansion |
| Semantic node descriptions | **28/28 ≥80%** (c2 green) — `describe_nodes.py --auto` via opencode; curated manifests for Cython/C-only surfaces (ADR-0008) |
| Community labels | **28/28 real** (c1 green) |
| Quality Gate | **28/28 GREEN** (c1–c6) — `scripts/graph_gate.py --ci --all` exits 0 |
| Skills | **136 `SKILL.md`** (27 routers + 97 modules + 12 playbooks); citation gate **1147/0**; `--require-complete` 28/28 in CI |
| Skill validation | validator v2 (sections/hash/related-skills, module-scoped API) gates `--ci`; API job live-checks 10 core libs (matrix expansion planned — QKG_070) |
| Cross-library bridges | **71/71 resolved**, injected as `_cross_library` overlay (63 nodes) |
| Docs | 126-doc governed corpus, `doc_audit.py --ci` green; concept index live; counts CI-gated (QKG_065) |
| CI | lint + docs + provenance + artifact-safety + release + pages + nightly-publish active; truth-counts diff gate (QKG_065) |

## Gold-standard bar (per library)

Re-extracted at a pinned commit with **real** descriptions + labels, **noise-filtered** god
nodes, every skill on the **one template**, every claim **traceable to a graph node** and
**validated against the live API**, cross-library **bridges as real edges**, and depth matched to
API importance. Full definitions: `docs/specs/GRAPH_SPEC.md` §5 and `docs/specs/SKILL_SPEC.md`.

## Phase 1 — Rebuild all 10 graphs, done right  ✅ (now 11 incl. statsmodels)

> **graphify runs here, from scratch, with NO API key / NO credits.** Verified 2026-08-06:
> code extraction is a local tree-sitter AST + Louvain pass (no LLM); node descriptions use
> graphify's **assistant mode** (emits batch prompts the assistant answers — still no key).
> End-to-end proof: ta-lib Python API re-extracted from scratch → 10/10 nodes described.
> Working invocation captured in `scripts/rebuild_graph.sh`. graphify install: isolated
> (`npm i @sentropic/graphify` in a dir whose parent has no node_modules), then `GRAPHIFY_CLI`.

- [x] Proven: `graphify extract <pkg> --no-description --no-label --exclude …` (local, no LLM)
- [x] Proven: `graphify describe` assistant loop ingests answers → real descriptions (no key)
- [x] `scripts/rebuild_graph.sh` uses the real, working invocation (package-dir + noise excludes)
- [x] `scripts/query_graph.py` accepts all 10 libraries
- [x] Run for all 10 (now 11 incl. statsmodels): clone@pin → extract → describe (opencode) → labels → prune → stamp
- [x] Every graph passes the Quality Gate (`docs/specs/GRAPH_SPEC.md` §5) — **11/11 green** (`scripts/graph_gate.py --ci --all`)

## Phase 6 — Library expansion (gated on the gold standard)

✅ **statsmodels** onboarded as a parallel stress wave (QKG_019, gate 5/5, 7 findings codified
in `docs/guides/onboarding-checklist.md`). ✅ **cvxpy** + **PyPortfolioOpt** onboarded through
the QKG_018 playbook (QKG_020): both graphs pass the quality gate on day one (c1–c6), skills
waves landed (cvxpy core/cone/problems + router; PyPortfolioOpt ef/risk/returns/bl + router;
statsmodels core + router), bridges extended 19→26, and every onboarded library now runs the
mandatory API-surface probe (checklist step 7.5, ADR-0008). Next in the queue: **arch,
riskfolio-lib, pyfolio, alphalens, polars, shap**. Rationale in `docs/archive/AUDIT.md` §5.2.
Every new library must pass the quality gate on day one (QKG_018 playbook).

- Phases are largely sequential (0 → 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5); Phases 2–3 fan out per-library and are

- Commit per phase so the before/after is legible in git history.
